title: The chart of his time in the Ellington band
summary: Portier's chart: August 1929 to March 1944, returns in 1951-53, February 1960 and 1961.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Okay. Have you ever seen this chart? It shows who was in the band when; it was done by a man in France, and it's got all the dates and where each person was in, and according to that, you came in in late August
of 1929, and stayed through March, 1944, except for about two weeks in January, 1938 when you weren't there for some reason.
Then it says you came back in February of '51 through November, '53, and you were there for 22 days in February, 1960, and from May to August of 1961. Does that sound right?
It's pretty accurate, I've found. (Interruption) That's the chart by Jay Portier. We skipped a bass player. Raglin, Just looked at a picture of Junior Ragland, right?
Uh huh. A nice bass player, and he could drink and hold it, too.
